last_edition.label: 2026, first MotoFest Bike Show (with round 3 of the NZ Superbike Championship)

organiser.name: Hampton Downs Motorsport Park (event created by Mike Marsden; backed by circuit owner Tony Quinn)

add_sources.note: Page read (21 Nov 2025): MotoFest Bike Show 6 to 8 March 2026 at Hampton Downs; MotoFest traditionally runs in the first week of March.
Google snippet: Star Insure MotoFest held 2 to 3 March 2024; with 2022 (5 to 6 Mar) and 2026 shows an annual March event.
Page read: MotoFest created by Mike Marsden; circuit owner Tony Quinn backed it from 2018 and the Hampton Downs Motorsport Park team still supports it.
Google snippet: 'the Hampton Downs-promoted Star Insure MotoFest'.

Page read: Bike Show backed by six manufacturers (Honda, Suzuki, Yamaha, Kawasaki, KTM, CF Moto) and accessories wholesalers Whites Powersports, Crown Kiwi, Forbes & Davies and Darbi. No title sponsor named for 2026.
Google snippet: Star Insurance new title sponsor for the 5 to 6 March 2022 edition.
Google snippet: 'The Star Insure Motofest comes to Hampton Downs in March 2022'.
Google snippet: 'The Star Insure MotoFest on March 2-3, 2024'. A 2022-23 season preview snippet also names the Star Insure MotoFest, covering the 2023 edition.
Google snippet: Shoei took naming rights for MotoFest on March 3 to 4 (year not shown in snippet).
Google snippet: MotoFest 2021 programme featured the Motul NZ Classic Grand Prix and Shoei Helmets-sponsored Classic Two Stroke races.
Page read: manufacturer and accessory displays at the Bike Show, plus a $10,000 gate prize redeemable at participating exhibitors.
Google snippet: 2026 Bike Show included demo rides, a custom bike display and a track ride with 400+ riders.

notes: Long-running Hampton Downs motorcycle racing festival, rebranded as the MotoFest Bike Show for 6 to 8 Mar 2026 with six manufacturers backing it. Past title sponsors Star Insure (2022 to 2024) and Shoei (year unclear). No event IG; Apify search hits were MotoFests in other countries.
